page: Microsoft Azure DC48eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the DCEDV6 server family. It is powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, delivering 48 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is provisioned with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The virtualization layer is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 2835 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. There are no integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) bundled with this instance, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the DC48eds_v6 balances a high vCPU count with substantial local storage and memory capacity, making it suitable for enterprise workloads. The combination of dedicated compute resources, large local disk capacity, and premium storage compatibility makes this instance appropriate for database hosting, memory-intensive applications, and enterprise-scale data processing workloads.
